description: Manual compacto: toolbar + filtros + fila 112 + tooltip de error
pre_capture_js: (() => { const existing = document.getElementById('codex-manual-tooltip-o9-2'); if (existing) existing.remove(); const viewport = document.querySelector('cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport'); if (viewport) { const newViewport = viewport.cloneNode(true); viewport.parentNode.replaceChild(newViewport, viewport); } const allRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('otto-web-grid-row')); allRows.forEach(row => { const keep = row.textContent.includes('112'); if (!keep) row.remove(); else { row.style.transform = 'none'; row.style.position = 'relative'; row.style.top = '0'; } }); const wrapper = document.querySelector('.cdk-virtual-scroll-content-wrapper'); if (wrapper) { wrapper.style.transform = 'none'; wrapper.style.position = 'relative'; wrapper.style.top = '0'; wrapper.style.display = 'flex'; wrapper.style.flexDirection = 'column'; } const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('otto-web-grid-row')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('112')); if (!row) return; const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const tip = document.createElement('div'); tip.id = 'codex-manual-tooltip-o9-2'; tip.textContent = "Le nombre de jours de jour de repos (4) entre le 27 avr. et le 3 mai d\u00e9passe la plage autoris\u00e9e [2, 3]"; tip.style.position = 'fixed'; tip.style.left = `${Math.max(235, rect.left + 210)}px`; tip.style.top = `${rect.bottom + 2}px`; tip.style.zIndex = '9999'; tip.style.background = '#02011a'; tip.style.color = '#ffffff'; tip.style.fontSize = '14px'; tip.style.lineHeight = '20px'; tip.style.padding = '6px 12px'; tip.style.borderRadius = '2px'; tip.style.boxShadow = '0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; tip.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap'; document.body.appendChild(tip); })();
